## Summary

What does this PR change? Link the issue it closes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Research (docs under `research/`)
- [ ] Code (Rust implementation)
- [ ] Docs/community files
- [ ] Fix

## Checklist

- [ ] Claims are tagged `[F]`/`[C]`/`[R]`/`[O]` with confidence levels (research PRs)
- [ ] Primary sources cited (kernel docs, OCI spec, man pages)
- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy` pass (code PRs)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (code PRs)
- [ ] No secrets or environment-specific details committed
